verdict.rationale: Partitioning converts files into typed document elements and metadata in a "contextualized" JSON format, and the chunk-by-title strategy implies titles are detected and used to group content into sections. However, the evidence never explicitly describes heading levels, parent/child section relationships, or reading-order handling, so hierarchy preservation is largely implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading/section hierarchy metadata (e.g., parent IDs or levels), reading-order guarantees for multi-column layouts, independent or hands-on corroboration of structure fidelity.
